description:
One provenance, identified so a record can join to it, and — for
everything but a document — a file a person can open (S-0060/D-1).

`id` is stable under renaming (S-0047/D-4): the corpus's is the document
identifier, `S-NNNN` (S-0058/D-1), which never changes and is never
reused (S-0016/D-17); every other kind's is `<kind>/<slug>` and must
equal the path its file sits at. `ref` is where the source currently
lives, and `ref` is the field that moves when a thing is renamed — which
is the whole reason the id is not the path.

at.description: When it arrived, `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ` (S-0058/D-7); empty when nobody said.
at.title: At

id.description: `S-NNNN` for a document, `<kind>/<slug>` for a filed source.
id.title: Id

kind.description: What this provenance is: a specification, an incident, an audit, a review or an ask.
kind.title: Kind

ref.description: Where it lives — a URL, an issue, a commit, a person; the field that moves.
ref.title: Ref

settled_by.description: The documents holding the rows this source settled, if it settled any (S-0060/D-2).
settled_by.title: Settled By

summary.description: What it said, in prose. Never rules — those are the corpus's (S-0060/D-2).
summary.title: Summary

title.description: What it is, in a line.
title.title: Title

title: Source
